title: Can I archive to yearly subfolders in Thunderbird Android?
creator: rik13
content:
I use Thunderbird both on desktop and Android. On desktop, I've got it set up to archive mails to subfolders based on year. In Thunderbird for Android, that function seems to be missing.

This results in inconsistent behaviour, and a difficult filtering experience when hunting for old mails that you forgot the exact title for.

A temporary workaround could be to set this year's archive folder as the default archive folder on Android, but that produces inconsistent behaviour again when archiving mails in january, when december mails still need to go to Archive > 2026 but january mails belong in Archive > 2027.

Is this functionality planned for a future Thunderbird-Android release?

Slightly related: Thunderbird Android seems to have created a duplicate Archive folder in my account. Now I have two folders identically named "Archive" :-)
